p.i: A revelation, including a part of the record of John the Beloved, given at Kirtland, Ohio, 6 May 1833, through Joseph Smith Jr. to Frederick G. Williams, Sidney Rigdon, Joseph Smith Jr., and Newel K. Whitney.

chapter.li: LEChapter93 Verse1 Truly thus says the Lord: It shall come to pass that every soul who forsakes their sins, and comes unto me, and calls on my name, and obeys my voice, and keeps all my commandments, shall see my face and know that I am, VerseEnd Verse2 and that I am the true light that lights every man who comes into the world, VerseEnd Verse3 and that I am in the Father and the Father in me, and the Father and I are one VerseEnd — Verse4 the Father because he gave me of his fullness, and the Son because I was in the world, and made flesh my tabernacle, and dwelt among the sons of men. VerseEnd

Verse5 I was in the world and received of my Father, and the works of him were plainly manifest. VerseEnd Verse6 And John saw and bore record of the fullness of my glory, and the fullness of John’s record is hereafter to be revealed. VerseEnd Verse7 And he bore record saying, I saw his glory, that he was in the beginning, before the world was. VerseEnd Verse8 Therefore, in the beginning the Word was, for he was the Word, even the Messenger of Salvation, VerseEnd Verse9 the Light and the Redeemer of the world, the Spirit of Truth, who came into the world because the world was made by him, and in him was the life of men and the light of men. VerseEnd Verse10 The worlds were made by him. Men were made by him. All things were made by him, and through him, and of him. VerseEnd

Verse11 And I, John, bear record that I beheld his glory, as the glory of the Only Begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth, even the Spirit of Truth which came and dwelt in the flesh, and dwelt among us. VerseEnd

Verse12 And I, John, saw that he received not of the fullness at the first, but received grace for grace. VerseEnd Verse13 And he received not of the fullness at first, but continued from grace to grace until he received a fullness, VerseEnd Verse14 and thus he was called, the Son of God, because he received not of the fullness at the first. VerseEnd

Verse15 And I, John, bear record and lo, the Heavens were opened, and the holy ghost descended upon him in the form of a dove and set upon him. And there came a voice out of Heaven saying, This is my Beloved Son. VerseEnd

Verse16 And I, John, bear record that he received a fullness of the glory of the Father. VerseEnd Verse17 And he received all power, both in Heaven and on earth, and the glory of the Father was with him, for he dwelt in him. VerseEnd

Verse18 And it shall come to pass that if you are faithful, you shall receive the fullness of the record of John. VerseEnd Verse19 I give unto you these sayings that you may understand and know how to worship, and know what you worship, that you may come unto the Father in my name, and in due time receive of his fullness, VerseEnd Verse20 for if you keep my commandments, you shall receive of his fullness and be glorified in me as I am glorified in the Father. Therefore, I say unto you, you shall receive grace for grace. VerseEnd

Verse21 And now truly I say unto you, I was in the beginning with the Father, and am the Firstborn, VerseEnd Verse22 and all those who are begotten through me are partakers of the glory of the same, and are the church of the Firstborn. VerseEnd Verse23 You were also in the beginning with the Father, that which is spirit, even the spirit of truth, VerseEnd Verse24 and truth is knowledge of things as they are, and as they were, and as they are to come; VerseEnd Verse25 and whatever is more or less than these is the spirit of that wicked one who was a liar from the beginning. VerseEnd

Verse26 The Spirit of Truth is of God. I am the Spirit of Truth. And John bore record of me, saying, He received a fullness of truth, yea, even all truth. VerseEnd Verse27 And no man receives a fullness unless he keeps his commandments. VerseEnd Verse28 He that keeps his commandments receives truth and light until he is glorified in truth and knows all things. VerseEnd

Verse29 Man was also in the beginning with God. Intelligence, or the light of truth, was not created or made, neither indeed can be. VerseEnd Verse30 All truth is independent in that sphere in which God has placed it to act for itself, as all intelligence also; otherwise, there is no existence. VerseEnd Verse31 Behold, here is the agency of man, and here is the condemnation of man, because that which was from the beginning is plainly manifest unto them, and they receive not the light, VerseEnd Verse32 and every man whose spirit receives not the light is under condemnation. VerseEnd Verse33 For man is spirit, the elements are eternal, and spirit and element, inseparably connected, receive a fullness of joy; VerseEnd Verse34 and when separated, man cannot receive a fullness of joy. VerseEnd Verse35 The elements are the tabernacle of God, yea, man is the tabernacle of God, even temples, and whatever temple is defiled, God shall destroy that temple. VerseEnd

Verse36 The glory of God is intelligence, or in other words, light and truth. VerseEnd Verse37 Light and truth forsake that evil one. VerseEnd Verse38 Every spirit of man was innocent in the beginning, and God having redeemed man from the Fall, man became again, in their infant state, innocent before God. VerseEnd Verse39 And that wicked one comes and takes away light and truth, through disobedience, from the children of men, and because of the tradition of their fathers. VerseEnd Verse40 But I have commanded you to bring up your children in light and truth. VerseEnd

Verse41 But truly I say unto you, my servant Frederick, you have continued under this condemnation. VerseEnd Verse42 You have not taught your children light and truth according to the commandments, and that wicked one has power as yet over you, and this is the cause of your affliction. VerseEnd Verse43 And now a commandment I give unto you, and if you will be delivered, you shall set in order your own house, for there are many things that are not right in your house. VerseEnd
Verse44 Truly I say unto my servant Sidney that in some things he has not kept the commandments concerning his children. Therefore, firstly set in order your house. VerseEnd

Verse45 And truly I say unto my servant Joseph, or in other words I will call you friends, for you are my friends and you shall have an inheritance with me. VerseEnd Verse46 I called you servants for the world’s sake, and you are their servants for my sake. VerseEnd Verse47 And now truly I say unto you, Joseph, you have not kept the commandments and must needs stand rebuked before the Lord. VerseEnd Verse48 Your family must needs repent and forsake some things and give more earnest heed unto your sayings or be removed out of their place. VerseEnd Verse49 What I say unto one, I say to all. Pray always, so that wicked one won't have power in you and remove you out of your place. VerseEnd

Verse50 My servant Newel also, the bishop of my church, has need to be chastened, and set in order his family and see that they are more diligent and concerned at home, and pray always, or they shall be removed out of their place. VerseEnd

Verse51 Now I say unto you, my friends, let my servant Sidney go his journey and make haste, and also proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord and the gospel of salvation as I shall give him utterance, and by your prayer of faith, with one consent, I will uphold him. VerseEnd

Verse52 And let my servants Joseph and Frederick make haste also, and it shall be given them even according to the prayer of faith. And inasmuch as you keep my sayings, you shall not be confounded, in this world nor in the world to come. VerseEnd Verse53 And truly I say unto you that it is my will that you should hasten to translate my scriptures, and to obtain a knowledge of history, and of countries, and of kingdoms, and of laws of God and man, and all this for the salvation of Zion. Amen. VerseEnd
